text:
mira: bringing up pelican13b-int4 on p4d-small canary. saw two soft OOMs during a short chat ramp. sharing logs/snippets.

jon: can you paste the canary runtime + traffic profile?

mira: initial config we used:
```json
{
  "model": "pelican13b-int4",
  "batch_size": 14,
  "max_new_tokens": 512,
  "prefetch": true,
  "slab_cushion_pct": 5
}
```

riley: 14 + prefetch + 512 is risky on p4d for long histories. Fragmentation + transient freelists likely.

mira: logs show kv_alloc failures then compactor churn:
```
[2026-05-10T11:02:09Z] ERROR kv_alloc failed size=96MB reason=freelist_fragmentation
[2026-05-10T11:02:09Z] WARN slot_compactor: pass freed=20MB duration_ms=48
[2026-05-10T11:02:10Z] ERROR gen_worker: allocation failed reserving 48MB for generation
```

jon: quick mitigation: reduce batch_size to 6, max_new_tokens to 256, prefetch=false, slab_cushion_pct=10, slot_compactor=aggressive. Also set kv_trim_threshold=0.6 and kv_max_entries=2048 for canary.

mira: applied patch and restarted canary pool. patch snippet:
```yaml
runtime:
  batching: { default_batch_size: 6 }
  generation: { max_new_tokens_default: 256 }
  prefetch_kv: false
  mem: { slab_cushion_pct: 10, slot_compactor: aggressive }
  kv: { kv_trim_threshold: 0.6, kv_max_entries: 2048 }
```

deploy-bot: canary rollout requested for pelican13b-int4 -> pool-p4d-small (4 hosts) by mira

riley: ran 3k synthetic requests after patch: OOMs=0, p99 latency +30ms vs baseline, throughput -12%. metrics: "OOMs:0 | p99: 380ms | avg:140ms"

jon: good stability trade. please run a small quality eval at reduced max_new_tokens (200 prompts). watch for truncation or missing completions.

mira: eval started. early embedding-sim median=0.985, 4/200 prompts show format differences only. no semantic loss so far.

riley: long-term action: add per-model safe-defaults in model-catalog derived from model size, quantization, and GPU family. Also add a preflight frag-smoke that ramps 0->25%->60% and checks alloc_fail rate.

infra-bot: ticket created: INF-4921 "model-catalog: conservative defaults for quantized large models + frag-smoke preflight" assigned to jon

mira: leaving canary open 8h. notes for onboarding checklist: start conservative batch/max_new, prefetch opt-in, set kv_trim defaults, run frag-smoke ramp, and require a 200-prompt eval when reducing max_new_tokens. :white_check_mark:
